thread:
Ava (Content): ok team — kicking off the launch plan for the new open-source "edge-deploy-kit" (starter for private inference + quick deploy workflows). goal: OSS post, 45-min webinar + 30-min hands-on lab, and a short benchmark narrative we can use in blog + tweets. :tada:
Priya (DevRel): love it. want the tutorial flow to be 20–30 mins for the lab so ppl can follow along. recommend 1) repo walkthrough, 2) local run, 3) quick perf check with our bench script.
Liam (PM): benchmark narrative — let's be explicit about the tradeoffs: latency vs cost for small-batch edge deployments. target metrics: p90 latency for 512 tokens, cost-per-inference delta vs hosted. do we have numbers yet?
Noah (SRE): I can run the quick matrix on an A10G-like node and a cpu-optimized edge sim. I'll post a short table tomorrow. For the lab we should include a telemetry snippet:
```
export RW_API_KEY=\"$RW_KEY\"
./bench/edge-bench --model rwd-mini --tokens 512 --concurrency 4
```
Priya (DevRel): nice. for the tutorial repo, propose folders: /quickstart, /bench, /deploy-templates, /workshop. keep commands copy-paste friendly.
Evelyn (Growth): webinar landing page / CTA needs a distinct conversion flow — OSS signups should map to a developer nurture track. can we attach utm=oss_edge_launch and feed to HubSpot? also want a short tweet thread and 2 exec quotes for press.
Ava (Content): yes on utm. draft CTA: "Try Edge Deploy Kit — local deploy in 5 mins. Join the webinar for a hands-on workshop." will iterate copy. quick idea for blog headline: "Edge Deploy Kit: a lightweight starter for private LLM inference" (open to better).
Priya (DevRel): speakers: Priya (devrel) + Liam (product) + Noah (ops). plan: 20-min demo, 15-min bench walkthrough, 10-min Q&A, 30-min optional lab breakout. record and post to YT + repo 'actions' to auto-run lab.
Noah (SRE): action items for me: 1) run bench matrix and add CSV to repo, 2) add a telemetry snippet that outputs minimal metrics (latency, tokens/sec), 3) prep a small docker image with everything preinstalled.
launch-bot: Reminder: set webinar date in calendar at least 3 weeks out. Use template "webinar-standard" to auto-create Zoom + registrant page.
Evelyn (Growth): timeline: draft blog + repo -> week 1, bench + assets -> week 2, webinar + promos -> week 3. paid social on day of webinar + 3 follow-up emails. promo copy to be short + developer-focused.
Ava (Content): I'll draft the blog + a 3-part tweet thread: 1) what it is, 2) benchmark highlight, 3) workshop CTA. sending first draft by EOD Friday.
Priya (DevRel): for the workshop hands-on, we should include a troubleshooting section: common errors, tips for small GPU vs CPU fallback, and a minimal fallback strategy using quantized models.
Liam (PM): inbound routing — Evan from Growth, can you map registrants to the 'oss_edge' leadflow and tag based on 'attended' vs 'registered'. if attendee opens >2 follow-up emails, escalate to AE (inbound).
Evelyn (Growth): yep — I'll create a new list in HubSpot and add a workflow that tags leads: utm_source=oss_edge_launch -> list: OSS Edge Registrants. attended -> add tag 'oss_edge:attended'. >2 opens -> lead_status=warm and notify AE channel.
Ava (Content): tiny demo snippet for blog (feel free to shorten):
```
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 redwood/edge-deploy-kit:latest 
# then
curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"Summarize this repo"}' 
```
Priya (DevRel): we'll add a short lab notebook with step-checks and expected outputs so folks can self-verify.
Noah (SRE): also adding a tiny k8s manifest for customers who want a minimal cluster deploy. will keep it single-file for the lab.
Ava (Content): okay — action list summary: Ava: blog draft + tweets; Priya: repo structure + lab guide; Noah: bench CSV + docker + k8s manifest; Liam: speaker notes + bench narrative; Evelyn: landing page + HubSpot workflow + promos. I'll compile a launch checklist once we have first drafts.
Liam (PM): thanks — ping me when drafts are up, we'll do a dry-run of the webinar one week before.
Evelyn (Growth): I'll book the calendar and set reminders. also propose a short pre-webinar survey (3 q's) to tailor the breakout labs.
Ava (Content): awesome — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for now. any blockers?
Priya (DevRel): none from my side. starting repo skeleton now.
Noah (SRE): bench run scheduled tomorrow morning, will drop results here.
Ava (Content): perfect — thanks everyone :rocket:
